title: Nasdaq Hits All-Time Highs With Rare Dot-Com Warning Sign
speaker: Drew Dosek

macro_themes.view: ~70% of index stocks below their 50-day while SPY/QQQ hit ATHs; only seen in dot-com, 2021, 2024 and each time met selling — but near term there is still room higher.
At 5.289%, he expects yields to taper slightly, letting indices push higher; high yields hurt indebted non-mega-caps.
AI data centers and robots drive long-term power demand; bullish nuclear/power names.
Strategic reserve restocking keeps oil elevated for 1-2 years even if Middle East conflict ends.
